spans.s:
(शि) r. 6th cl. (कुडति)
1 To play or act as a child, to trifle.
2 To eat.
3 To heap.
(इ,) कुडि r. 1st cl. (कुंडति)
1 To confound or disorder with grief or pain.
2 To form, to make.
(कुण्डते)
To burn, to heat.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (कुंडति कुण्डयति)
To preserve.

r. 6th cl. (कूडति)
1 To be or become firm or solid.
2 To eat.
3 To graze.

m. (-पः)
A measure: see the next.

m. (-वः)
A measure of grain, wood, iron, &c. the fourth part of a Prastha, described by some as a vessel four fingers wide, and as many deep, and containing twelve Prakṛtis or handfuls: it is also said to contain thirteen and a half cubic Aṅgulas; or to be a finger and a half deep, and three fingers each length and breadth. In medicine it is equal to two Prakṛtis or thirty-two Tolakas.
E.
कुड to heap, कवन् affix; also कुडप and कुटप.

m. (-डिः)
The body.
E.
कुड to burn, इ Uṇādi aff.

f. (-का)
An earthen or wooden water pot used by ascetics.

m. (-शः)
A fish, commonly Kūrci, (Cyprinus curchius, HAM.)

m. (-पः)
The clasp or fastening of a necklace or bracelet.

m. (-लः)
A new bud: see कुट्मल.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Budded, blossomed.
2 Cheerful, smiling, (as the countenance.)
E.
कुद्मल and इतच् aff.

n. (-ड्यं)
1 A wall.
2 Anointing, plastering.
3 Eagerness, curiosity.
E.
कु to sound, and ड्यन् affix, or कुड to heap, &c. and क्यप् affix; also कूड्य.

n. (-कं)
A wall: see the preceding, कन् being added.

m. (-दी)
A thief, a housebreaker.
E.
कुड्य a wall, and छेदिन् who cuts or breaks.

n. (-द्यं)
An opening, a hole in a wall, a breach.
E.
कुड्य a wall, and छेट्ट्य to be broken.

mf. (-त्स्यः-त्स्यी)
A house lizard.
E.
कुड्य a wall, and मत्स्य a fish.
